stage: fixed S3 cross-block sketch visibility audit
inputs: existing licensed SMPL-H assets and original S3 analytic cameras/pixels
frozen: G0 numerical medoid anchor and standardized central-difference J at1e-4; original candidates, masks, IDs, reasons and seeds; no neural model execution
mask_definition: COCO17: wrists9,10; upper5..10; lower11..16. Counterfactual admitted rows only; never alter saved source masks. Coordinates from original full J selected in view-major point xy order. Anchor frozen for all cells; not a new occluded-anchor estimate.
precision_axis: full admitted mask only: isotropic sigma5/10/20px plus sigma_x5_y10px anisotropic. Mask axis always sigma10px. Axes varied separately.
measure: off-block Frobenius energy; each token row block projected onto column span of the probes restricted to outside-token coordinates. Reconstructed energy / original energy in[0,1]. This is a Euclidean reconstruction diagnostic, not percentage of Fisher information or accuracy retained. Raw sketch norm ratio separately can exceed1.
projection: fixed seed20261012 and3/10probes; no seed selection, no candidate resampling
controls: baseline discards all cross blocks; full external matrix as reconstruction reference; QR/SVD orthogonal projection checks with known span and nullspace
success: all cells and unavailable cases recorded; source caches unchanged; global precision scale invariance of reconstruction fraction checked; geometry metadata explicit
stop_rule: if baseline full-mask unseen cross energy exceeds80%, suspend current sketch as a broadly informative conditioning candidate and do not tune more probe seeds. This is an engineering screening rule, not an efficacy gate. Preserve code as diagnostic control.
boundaries: one artificial S3 observation using real statistical decoder
no Fisher-information guarantee from Frobenius energy
